title: Taste of Sevilla
text: Fantastic tour, Anna, our guide was lovely, very knowledgeable and great company. We learned a lot about local food and culture and the places we ate at were just fantastic. I would highly recommend
author: Stu_Hill_UK

title: Unforgettable evening
text:
Caterina (Cate) organised the tapas tour very well.
The venues were all in the know and we were expected.
Caterina talks enthusiastically about Seville, the local customs and what to expect from tapas.
It’s a family and friends affair, all about making time for one another. Each tapas dish was paired with a drink, and we were given an explanation of those too. 
Afterwards, we received further details about the tapas and drinks via the app 👌
Thank you for the lovely and unforgettable evening – we’d highly recommend it to everyone!!
author: F9484SOlaurad

title: Food tour
text: Our Guide Caterina was such a kind and funny person. We told us a lot about Sevilla in particular and gave us many information about the local and national food. The tour was about 3h and we went to 4 different places to eat various things. I would really recommend this experience this Tour to people who like to eat and want to try local Sevillan food
author: alinasL1917EK

title: Seville food and drink walkabout
text: Cate was a terrific guide. Knowledgeable,  interesting and a really good communicator.  Her enthusiasm was infectious and the food and drink choices imaginative and authentic. An excellent evening.
author: W1643MWgrahamd

title: Food
text: The tour was amazing. Our guide was Cate and she did a window tour with a good mix of history, (a lot of) food and friendly talk.  It felt naturally with her and we did really enjoy our time together.
author: shivanyau2026

title: The bear Seville style food and drink experience
text: Our guide Catherina really knew all about Seville food and drink.  She explained it all very well, kept us all involved and was a great guide.  All the food and drink samples was excellent
